notes: The editor's gloss «- يعني ابن سلمة -» is left out (rule 1); the name is «محمد» as the text writes it before the gloss.
«قال إن سهلا والله أوهم الحديث» is a remark on Sahl's error, not a link; Sahl is not written as a transmitter here.
«قال فوداه ...» continues the saying and is not a link.
